references.text: Israel stayed in Shittim, the same place from which Joshua sent out the spies.
Moses also sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, just as Joshua did.
The instructions Moses gave to the spies resemble the mission Joshua gave his spies.
Rahab and her family were spared because of her help to the spies.
Joshua fulfilled the promise the spies made to Rahab, and she became part of the people of Israel.
Rahab is mentioned as an example of faith because she received the spies in peace.
James uses Rahab as an example that faith without works is dead, since she received the spies.
Rahab is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the mother of Boaz.
